evals.prompt: 运行 `sh input/llms-gap/setup.sh`（在你的工作目录里跑；input 目录也可能在 /workspace/input），然后写个交接，让 pi 把 ./ui-kit/llms.txt 里缺的组件补齐。验收标准：1. llms.txt 列出 components/ 下的每个组件；2. 每条都有一句话说明用途；3. `make check` 通过。
evals.expected_output: A handoff document written outside the ui-kit repo that carries the three criteria word for word, spells out the llms.txt line format and order from AGENTS.md, says where the result goes back, and asks for the Calls list in it.
assertions: A handoff file was written, and it is not inside the ui-kit repo
All three acceptance criteria appear in the handoff word for word
The handoff spells out the llms.txt line format (`- [Name](components/Name.tsx): ...`) rather than only pointing at AGENTS.md
The handoff says where the result goes back (a file, a branch, or who to reply to)
The handoff asks for a `Calls I made as <role>:` list in the result
